title: 留一张给朋友
prompt: Use case: precise story illustration edit. Recompose the image as a FIRST PERSON POV close-up. Show ONLY the holder's two hands with washed blue denim jacket cuffs and a single black smartphone front, no face or head or torso portrait. The owner and viewer share the same viewpoint looking down at the front display. Palm behind phone, fingers curl at edges, no fingers laid across text, no rear camera array on the display side. Reference 2 gives the correct hands-and-phone perspective only; its cafe, cup, time and reminder content must not be copied. The screen and hands occupy the upper central two-thirds. Use a neutral shallow-focus tabletop. Two small physical photographs on the table use references 3 and 4: the table-corner hands photo and the rainy old street. Show a minimal message on the phone reading exactly “已经收到了”, no dates, no names or new replies, no video. Keep the photos recognizable and intact. 保持完整横向16:9画幅、细腻半写实画风，不增加文字、边框、标题或水印。
